baseline.method: Original COPRA1000 on real processed Regen,seed1234

complex_relative_l2_definition: Full complex L2 difference/reference L2 after global phase/continuous periodic translation/optional conjugate-time-reversal; no masks or amplitude fit
coherent_overlap_definition: Absolute Hermitian normalized inner product; complex cosine, no mean subtraction
trace_R_definition: RMS measured-minus-gain*predicted SHG intensity / measured maximum; actual offgrid delays, fitted positive gain
reference_type: validated method result, not physical truth
